params.prompt: Premium Korean mobile-app performance ad key visual for Meta feed, 4:5 vertical. High-end glossy 3D render, studio lighting, soft shadows, crisp details, eye-catching. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people, no hands, no money. Leave the upper 35% of the frame as clean empty background for a big headline and the bottom 15% clean for a CTA button. Concept: peer comparison report arriving as a notification. A glossy smartphone lies tilted in the lower center; a 3D envelope bursts open from its screen and a report card with a bar chart flies out: one tall orange bar and one short empty dashed red outline bar with a question mark shape (no letters). Confetti-like light particles. Warm ivory and soft orange pastel background.
